description: Kernel command lines and the layout of a layered root that nvx::protocol::root parses from each, null for none, or the error with which it refuses the command line. The tests of nvx-rs replay them, and scripts/test_nvx_tools.py replays them through the shell init, guest/common/nvx-init-agent, which reads the same tokens: it accepts what the parser accepts of an EROFS image over either upper, and refuses everything else, with shell_error in its message where a case names one. It reads the tokens of a RAM upper beside a scratch block device too, and refuses that device when it finds it in /proc/iomem, where the kernel lists the virtio-mmio devices that it added.
